ios.desc:
Pocket Rocket keeps track of all upcoming SpaceX rocket launches, and reminds you of when they're happening. Launch dates change constantly, so we act as your launch concierge to make sure you never miss out on witnessing history. 

With this app, you can view existing and future rocket models, receive critical updates about launches, livestream new launches, watch each historical launch, and see your favorite rocket in Augmented Reality. 

Base Features for All Users:
- Day-Of Reminder notification about every Upcoming Launch.
- Full access to all features of the app! What you see is what you get.
- See dates and countdowns for each launch, so you know exactly when they will happen. 
- Interact with your favorite rockets in a 3D view, and in AR. 
- Livestream every launch directly from the app!

Subscription Tiers: 
Pocket Rocket Plus
- All the Base features.
- Receive Launch Updates and Detailed Reminders. 
- Updates for when a launch date changes just before a launch is expected to happen.
- Reminders for each upcoming launch, from T - 1 Week, T - 24 Hrs/12 Hrs (it varies), T - 1 Hr, and T - 5 Minutes. 

Pocket Rocket Silver
- All the Base features.
- All Launch Updates and Reminders
- Support the development of the app. This helps us continue building Pocket Rocket full-time. 
- A Silver Decal in your app to display your level of support.
- Exclusive future features to further display your level of support! 

Pocket Rocket Gold
- All the Base features.
- All Launch Updates and Reminders
- Support the development of the app.
- A Gold Decal in your app to display your level of support.
- Exclusive future features to further display your level of support! 


We hope you'll love it. 

(Disclaimer: This is app is not affiliated with SpaceX or its partners or customers)
